name: Grant or funding proposal
purpose: Make a credible case for funding a defined programme of work.
audience: Technical reviewers, funders and selection panels.
promptRules: Make the need specific and evidenced.
Convert ambition into deliverables and measures.
State why this team can execute.
Do not use world-class, transformative or innovative as substitutes for design detail.
Link each activity to an output, outcome and verification method.
